dialog.removeBody: Readers will see that it was removed by staff, along with the reason, and the owner will be notified. The {{count}} pending report(s) on this item will be resolved.
dialog.removeProfileBody: This pen name's {{posts}} post(s), {{threads}} discussion(s) and {{comments}} comment(s) will be removed too. The account and its other pen names are not affected.
dialog.banBody: The account will be signed out on every device and can no longer sign in. All tokens and MCP connections stop working. Works, pen names, posts and comments are kept for now and removed automatically 6 months after the ban.
dialog.dismissBody: Nothing will change on the content. The pending reports will be marked as dismissed.
dialog.closeBody: The author has already deleted this content. The pending reports will be marked as resolved.
